'''Lenstrum Market''' was an old market located in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] a deal was being conducted in the market between arms dealers and [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] operatives, which was interrupted by Imperials hired by [[Factor Jarvus]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lenstrum Market appear as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
